review_stages.trigger: STAGE and PERCH landed (with POOL, HOSTKIT, GREEN)
review_stages.scope: Boots: an empty instance starts, stops, is killed and restarts; status truthful; nothing left over (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)
Holds plans: the canary saved, edited and re-saved as typed records; nothing runs; a stale save refused (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)
Dispatches: only admitted, ready tasks start in dependency order; the pool and manager reserve hold; a killed worker frees its slot without leaks (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)
Works: real Haiku workers in their own labs; checks through the runner within heavy units; task/check/ask/done; evidence verifies (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)

review_stages.trigger: LAND landed; SKEL0 is the run
review_stages.scope: Lands: one landing per task, checked on the exact merged commit; labs deleted; nothing left over (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)

review_stages.trigger: MGR, ASK, REWORK, CHANGE, ACT, LANEFIX, LIVENESS landed
review_stages.scope: Manages: failure resumes the same session; manager wakes only for judgment; answers reach the asker; a second project activates while the first runs (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)

review_stages.trigger: A3, A4, RETIRE, A6, CONV landed
review_stages.scope: Dogfood: the program saved into staging; two real program tasks dispatched and landed by Otto (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)
Switch-over: every upcoming project present by diff; clients on the new owner; the old paths unreferenced; disk freed (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)
Many: cold Claude and Codex journeys; sustainable concurrency; heavy seconds per accepted task; renders without deadlock (PLAN.md §16; perch report ops/perch/<stage>/)

review_stages.trigger: MANY done and STAGE8 reviewed (the end of edition 1, before PROGRAM#edition-1)
review_stages.scope: edition 1 against PLAN.md section 1, read with every stage perch report: the end state works, nothing leaks, every invariant in the XHARD column holds
Can this be run as written: ambiguities a Haiku manager would hit, checks that pass while the outcome is wrong, rows inviting fleet code into src/otto, process to cut (PLAN.md §16)
The model's shape: one source of truth per fact, the smallest schema for the end state, follow-ups and superseded projects without special cases, Store growth (PLAN.md §16)
Layering and over-engineering: herzchen/fleet usable by a second product unchanged, two mechanisms for one purpose, what the skeleton doesn't need, the agent's journey (PLAN.md §16)
What else depends on the old Store or its run folders beyond the saved projects; what would be regretted; is the rollback real until the delete (PLAN.md §16)
A cold Codex journey on staging (--write), and the end state against PLAN.md section 1; what a third host would need (PLAN.md §16)

review_note: Opus budget: 15 calls = 9 stage reviews + 1 final + 5 reserve (oracle.max_calls). Re-reviews of a failed stage come from the reserve. Astra budget: 5 calls, all scheduled (ASTRA0-ASTRA4). Both counted in ops/STATUS.log by ops/launch_review.sh.

astra.note: A second model family (the user, 15 Oct, late). Opus judges whether it works; Astra judges the shape. Each runs alongside its stage's Opus review, independently. All five are scheduled; no reserve. Launched with ops/launch_review.sh ID astra.
